1. Overall Description

1.1 Assumptions

This system is designed based on the following assumptions:

  • The ASP.NET Core framework will continue to be actively supported and maintained by Microsoft, ensuring long-term stability and compatibility with evolving technologies.
  • Razor Pages and RESTful API architecture will remain a scalable and efficient choice for modular web application development.
  • SQL Server and cloud platforms will continue to provide reliable, scalable, and secure database services suitable for handling user data, course enrollments, transactions, cart records, and learning progress.
  • Modern web browsers (e.g., Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari) will continue to support necessary front-end standards including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and responsive web design.
  • The application will be deployed in environments with stable internet access to ensure seamless real-time interactions such as video streaming and instructor communication.
  • Users (Students, Instructors, Staff, Admins) are familiar with basic web application navigation, such as clicking buttons, navigating menus, and filling forms.

This system is also designed based on the following risks:

  • Any deprecation or major changes in ASP.NET Core or SQL Server might require significant refactoring of backend logic or data access layers.
  • Cross-browser inconsistencies or outdated device software may affect the UI/UX performance or appearance.
  • Cybersecurity threats such as injection attacks, token hijacking, or database breaches could compromise sensitive information if not proactively managed.
  • Network connectivity issues could disrupt access to course videos, purchasing features, or learning materials.

1.2 Design Constraints

This system should comply with the following items:

a. Platform Compatibility:

The Course Marketplace application must be compatible with modern web browsers (e.g., Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari) for all user roles including Student, Instructor, Staff, and Admin. The frontend is designed using Razor Pages, and the backend is powered by ASP.NET Core. Responsive web design principles must be applied to ensure a consistent and accessible user experience across desktops, tablets, and mobile browsers.

b. Integration Complexity:

The Course Marketplace platform integrates various components including ASP.NET Core (backend), SQL Server (database), third-party payment gateways, and cloud hosting services. Communication between client and server is handled via RESTful APIs secured with JWT. The system also integrates with services for email notifications, real-time chat (SignalR), and video content delivery (e.g., Cloudinary). Design decisions must support smooth integration, avoid tight coupling, and enable reliable data synchronization across modules.

c. Performance Requirements:

The application must ensure acceptable responsiveness and scalability under concurrent usage. Course enrollments, cart operations, real-time chat, and video content access must execute with minimal latency. Design must consider indexing, query optimization, and caching strategies in the database layer, along with efficient rendering techniques in the frontend.

1.3 Technology Suggestion

Course Marketplace adopts a RESTful API architecture to facilitate secure, stateless, and scalable communication between the frontend (Razor Pages) and the backend (ASP.NET Core). This approach allows for:

  • Modular and reusable API endpoints for account management, course management, cart handling, order processing, and instructor communication.
  • Easy integration with mobile applications, third-party services, or future external clients.
  • Secure access via JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for authentication and authorization across different user roles.
  • Support for standard HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE), making the system intuitive and easy to maintain.
  • Clear separation between presentation and business logic layers, ensuring better organization and testability.

RESTful APIs ensure interoperability and future-proofing for Course Marketplace, making it easier to expand across multiple platforms without tightly coupling components.

Figure 1. RestFullAPI

1.4 ASP.NET Core Framework

Marketplace is built using ASP.NET Core, a high-performance, cross-platform web framework developed by Microsoft. It is selected for its:

  • Rich ecosystem and strong community support
  • Integrated support for RESTful API development
  • Excellent security and performance out-of-the-box
  • Seamless integration with Entity Framework Core and SQL Server for data persistence
  • Compatibility with scalable cloud deployment

ASP.NET Core ensures the backend is both secure and extensible, ideal for enterprise-grade systems like Course Marketplace.

5. Database Design

5.1 Database Diagram

Figure 318. Database Diagram[305]

5.2 Database Tables Description

No

Table

Description

01

accounts

- Primary key: account_id: SERIAL
- Foreign keys: None
- Unique constraints:

  • email: VARCHAR(255)
  • username: VARCHAR(255)

- Attributes:

  • account_id: SERIAL (NOT NULL)
  • email: VARCHAR(255) (NOT NULL)
  • username: VARCHAR(255)
  • password_hash: TEXT
  • phone_number: VARCHAR(50)
  • account_status: VARCHAR(50)
  • account_flag_count: INT
  • auth_provider: VARCHAR(50)
  • avatar_url: TEXT
  • refresh_token: TEXT
  • refresh_token_expiry_time: TIMESTAMP
  • is_verified: BOOLEAN (NOT NULL)
  • account_created_at: TIMESTAMP
  • account_updated_at: TIMESTAMP
  • account_last_login_at: TIMESTAMP

02

lockouts

- Primary key: lockout_id: SERIAL
- Foreign keys:

  • account_id: INT

- Attributes:

  • lockout_id: SERIAL (NOT NULL)
  • account_id: INT
  • lockout_type: VARCHAR(50)
  • lockout_level: VARCHAR(50)
  • lockout_start: TIMESTAMP
  • lockout_end: TIMESTAMP

03

users

- Primary key: user_id: INT
- Foreign keys:

  • user_id: INT

- Attributes:

  • user_id: INT (NOT NULL)
  • full_name: VARCHAR(255) (NOT NULL)
  • bio: TEXT
  • date_of_birth: DATE

04

managers

- Primary key: manager_id: INT
- Foreign keys:

  • manager_id: INT

- Attributes:

  • manager_id: INT (NOT NULL)
  • role: VARCHAR(50)
  • display_name: VARCHAR(255) (NOT NULL)
  • full_name: VARCHAR(255)
  • phone_number: VARCHAR(50)
  • avatar_url: TEXT
  • bio: TEXT

05

instructors

- Primary key: instructor_id: INT
- Foreign keys:

  • instructor_id: INT

- Attributes:

  • instructor_id: INT (NOT NULL)
  • stripe_account_id: VARCHAR(255)
  • stripe_onboarding_status: VARCHAR(50)
  • payouts_enabled: BOOLEAN
  • charges_enabled: BOOLEAN
  • professional_title: VARCHAR(255)
  • expertise_categories: VARCHAR(255)
  • linkedin_url: TEXT
  • youtube_url: TEXT
  • facebook_url: TEXT
  • document_url: TEXT
  • approval_status: VARCHAR(50)
  • stripe_country: VARCHAR(2)
  • rejection_reason: TEXT

06

categories

- Primary key: category_id: SERIAL
- Foreign keys: None
- Attributes:

  • category_id: SERIAL (NOT NULL)
  • categories_name: VARCHAR(255) (NOT NULL)
  • description: TEXT
  • created_at: TIMESTAMP
  • updated_at: TIMESTAMP
  • category_status: VARCHAR(50)

07

coupons

- Primary key: coupon_id: SERIAL
- Foreign keys:

  • manager_id: INT

- Unique constraints:

  • coupon_code: VARCHAR(50)

- Attributes:

  • coupon_id: SERIAL (NOT NULL)
  • manager_id: INT
  • coupon_code: VARCHAR(50) (NOT NULL)
  • coupon_type: VARCHAR(50)
  • discount_value: NUMERIC(10, 2) (NOT NULL)
  • min_order_value: NUMERIC(10, 2) (NOT NULL)
  • start_date: TIMESTAMP
  • end_date: TIMESTAMP
  • usage_limit: INT
  • used_count: INT
  • is_active: BOOLEAN

08

courses

- Primary key: course_id: SERIAL
- Foreign keys:

  • instructor_id: INT
  • category_id: INT
  • coupon_id: INT

- Attributes:

  • course_id: SERIAL (NOT NULL)
  • instructor_id: INT
  • category_id: INT
  • coupon_id: INT
  • title: VARCHAR(255) (NOT NULL)
  • description: TEXT
  • price: NUMERIC(10, 2) (NOT NULL)
  • course_thumbnail_url: TEXT
  • created_at: TIMESTAMP
  • updated_at: TIMESTAMP
  • course_status: VARCHAR(50)
  • course_flag_count: INT
  • what_you_will_learn: TEXT
  • requirements: TEXT
  • moderation_feedback: TEXT
  • last_approved_at: TIMESTAMP
  • is_removed: BOOLEAN
  • threat_level: INT

09

lessons

- Primary key: lesson_id: SERIAL
